# Unit3 consolidation workbook — week15
Four lessons, original draft 14 October 2026.
L1: bring week 14 evidence. Select one programming and one networking priority. Record initial answer/confidence and the precise misconception. Use chapter/station guidance for baseline questions.
L2: complete selected station cards; show traces/calculations and explain the rule. If secure, extend to nested mutable values, search preparation/update costs or policy bypass paths. Record help used.
L3 fresh mixed transfer (about 25 minutes):
T1: data={"kits":[2,4]}; snapshot=data.copy(); snapshot["kits"].append(6). Give both mappings and explain independence requirements.
T2: stable quantity sort K09:3,K07:1,K08:3. Give order, justify whether ID binary search can be used directly, and test an empty/one/last/absent ID-sorted search.
T3: stock 2; loan 1 succeeds; return succeeds; same return repeated. State expected stock after each, invariant and guard. Explain a component test versus workflow acceptance test.
T4: host 192.168.70.67/27. Give mask, network,broadcast,ordinary host range/capacity. Validate gateway.65 and destination.100. A group needs 28endpoints plus 1gateway: choose smallest ordinary LAN prefix and justify.
T5:12 clients x9 Mbit/s across 100 Mbit/s; calculate demand/ideal equal share.400 MB at 80 Mbit/s: ideal time and one limitation.
T6: Visitor VLAN and Staff VLAN route freely, no rules. Draw the policy boundary and specify an allowed service plus denied new initiation. Explain why a failed guest ping alone is insufficient proof of all-protocol isolation.
L4: delayed fresh retry for each priority, then revision-plan CSV. Confirm live-tool practice and Cisco symbol evidence separately; no school network changes are required here.
